<file path="app/templates/admin/pos/_pos_scripts.html">
{#
  app/templates/admin/pos/_pos_scripts.html
  =========================================
  GUAMAISON POS Terminal Logic - Full Version

  Đồng bộ với POS UI mới:
  - Tìm sản phẩm / SKU / barcode / camera scanner.
  - Lưới sản phẩm nhanh.
  - Chọn biến thể size / màu.
  - Giỏ hàng.
  - Khách hàng / thêm khách mới / loyalty.
  - Nhân viên thanh toán.
  - Coupon / khuyến mãi.
  - Bảng giá.
  - Phí vận chuyển.
  - VAT / hóa đơn VAT.
  - Giao hàng sau.
  - Thuộc tính đơn hàng.
  - Ghi chú đơn hàng.
  - Tiền mặt / chuyển khoản QR.
  - Polling xác nhận chuyển khoản.
  - In hóa đơn 80mm.
#}

<script>
(function () {
  "use strict";

  const CSRF_TOKEN = "{{ csrf_token() }}";
  const CHECKOUT_URL = "{{ url_for('admin.pos_checkout') }}";
  const CUSTOMER_CREATE_URL = "/admin/pos-create-customer";
  const CUSTOMER_LOOKUP_URL = "/admin/pos-lookup-customer";

  const STORE_BANK_CODE = "TCB";
  const STORE_BANK_ACCOUNT = "{{ pos_store_account|default('4890440016335294') }}";
  const STORE_BANK_NAME = "GUAMAISON";

  const POINT_REDEEM_VALUE = Number("{{ point_redeem_value|default(100) }}") || 100;
  const VAT_DEFAULT_RATE = Number("{{ vat_default_rate|default(0.08) }}") || 0.08;

  const POS = {
    db: [],
    cart: [],

    method: "cash",

    pricebookId: "default",

    deliveryLater: false,
    deliveryInfo: {},

    vatEnabled: false,
    vatRate: VAT_DEFAULT_RATE,
    vatInfo: {},

    orderAttributes: [],

    _variantProduct: null,
    _selectedColor: null,
    _selectedSize: null,

    _scannerBuffer: "",
    _scannerTimer: null,

    _pollTimer: null,
    _pendingInvoice: null,

    _cameraOn: false,
    _toastTimer: null,
    _searchTimer: null,

    _lastTotals: {
      subtotal: 0,
      couponDiscount: 0,
      pointDiscount: 0,
      discount: 0,
      points: 0,
      shippingFee: 0,
      vatAmount: 0,
      total: 0,
      qty: 0
    },

    /* =========================================================
       INIT
       ========================================================= */

    init() {
      this.db = this._readProductsData();
      this.pricebookId = this.$("#posPricebook")?.value || "default";

      this.renderGrid();
      this.renderCart();
      this.setMethod("cash");
      this._bindEvents();
      this._initUsbScanner();
      this._syncOptionalPanels();
      this._syncCheckoutLabel();

      const search = this.$("#posSearch");
      if (search && window.innerWidth >= 768) {
        window.setTimeout(() => search.focus(), 150);
      }
    },

    _readProductsData() {
      const el = this.$("#products-data");

      if (!el) return [];

      try {
        const data = JSON.parse(el.textContent || "[]");
        return Array.isArray(data) ? data : [];
      } catch (error) {
        console.error("[POS] Không đọc được products-data:", error);
        return [];
      }
    },

    _bindEvents() {
      document.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
        const target = event.target;

        const dropdown = this.$("#posDropdown");
        const search = this.$("#posSearch");

        if (
          dropdown &&
          search &&
          !dropdown.contains(target) &&
          target !== search &&
          !target.closest("[data-pos-dropdown-item]")
        ) {
          this._hide(dropdown);
        }

        const productBtn = target.closest("[data-pos-product-id]");
        if (productBtn) {
          event.preventDefault();
          this.handleSelect(productBtn.dataset.posProductId);
          return;
        }

        const cartPlus = target.closest("[data-cart-inc]");
        if (cartPlus) {
          event.preventDefault();
          this.updateQty(cartPlus.dataset.cartInc, 1);
          return;
        }

        const cartMinus = target.closest("[data-cart-dec]");
        if (cartMinus) {
          event.preventDefault();
          this.updateQty(cartMinus.dataset.cartDec, -1);
          return;
        }

        const cartRemove = target.closest("[data-cart-remove]");
        if (cartRemove) {
          event.preventDefault();
          this.removeItem(cartRemove.dataset.cartRemove);
          return;
        }

        const colorBtn = target.closest("[data-variant-color]");
        if (colorBtn) {
          event.preventDefault();
          this._pickColor(colorBtn.dataset.variantColor);
          return;
        }

        const sizeBtn = target.closest("[data-variant-size]");
        if (sizeBtn) {
          event.preventDefault();
          this._pickSize(sizeBtn.dataset.variantSize);
          return;
        }

        const closeModal = target.closest("[data-pos-close-modal]");
        if (closeModal) {
          event.preventDefault();
          this.closeAllModals();
        }
      });

      document.addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
        if (event.key === "F2") {
          event.preventDefault();
          this.$("#posSearch")?.focus();
          return;
        }

        if (event.key === "F3") {
          event.preventDefault();
          this.$("#customerPhone")?.focus();
          return;
        }

        if (event.key === "F5" && !event.ctrlKey && !event.metaKey) {
          event.preventDefault();
          this.resetCart();
          return;
        }

        if (event.key === "F9") {
          event.preventDefault();
          this.submit();
          return;
        }

        if (event.key === "Escape") {
          this._hide(this.$("#posDropdown"));
          this.closeVariantModal();
          this.closeCameraScanner();
          this.closeCustomerModal();
          this.closeDeliveryModal();
          this.closeVatModal();
          this.closeAttributesModal();
        }
      });

      this.$("#posSearch")?.addEventListener("input", () => {
        window.clearTimeout(this._searchTimer);
        this._searchTimer = window.setTimeout(() => this.filterProducts(), 80);
      });

      this.$("#customerPhone")?.addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
        if (event.key === "Enter") {
          event.preventDefault();
          this.lookupCustomer();
        }
      });

      this.$("#inputCash")?.addEventListener("input", (event) => {
        this._fmtMoneyInput(event.target);
        this.calcChange();
      });

      this.$("#posShippingFee")?.addEventListener("input", (event) => {
        this._fmtMoneyInput(event.target);
        this.calcTotal();
      });

      this.$("#posCoupon")?.addEventListener("change", () => {
        this.calcTotal();
      });

      this.$("#redeemPoints")?.addEventListener("input", () => {
        this.calcTotal();
      });

      this.$("#posPricebook")?.addEventListener("change", (event) => {
        this.pricebookId = event.target.value || "default";
        this.showToast("Đã đổi bảng giá", true);
      });

      window.addEventListener("resize", () => {
        this._syncOptionalPanels();
      });
    },

    _syncOptionalPanels() {
      this._setText("#txtShippingFee", this.fmt(this._getShippingFee()));
      this._setText("#txtVAT", this.fmt(this._lastTotals.vatAmount || 0));
    },

    /* =========================================================
       DOM HELPERS
       ========================================================= */

    $(selector, root = document) {
      return root.querySelector(selector);
    },

    $all(selector, root = document) {
      return Array.from(root.querySelectorAll(selector));
    },

    _show(el, displayClass = "flex") {
      if (!el) return;

      el.classList.remove("hidden");
      el.classList.add(displayClass);
      el.style.display = displayClass === "block" ? "block" : "";
    },

    _hide(el, displayClass = "flex") {
      if (!el) return;

      el.classList.remove(displayClass);
      el.classList.add("hidden");
      el.style.display = "none";
    },

    _lockPage(lock) {
      document.documentElement.classList.toggle("overflow-hidden", Boolean(lock));
      document.body.classList.toggle("overflow-hidden", Boolean(lock));
    },

    _openOverlay(modal, content) {
      if (!modal) return;

      modal.classList.remove("hidden");
      modal.classList.add("flex");
      this._lockPage(true);

      window.requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        modal.classList.remove("opacity-0");
        modal.classList.add("opacity-100");

        if (content) {
          content.classList.remove("scale-95", "translate-y-4");
          content.classList.add("scale-100", "translate-y-0");
        }
      });
    },

    _closeOverlay(modal, content) {
      if (!modal) return;

      modal.classList.remove("opacity-100");
      modal.classList.add("opacity-0");

      if (content) {
        content.classList.remove("scale-100", "translate-y-0");
        content.classList.add("scale-95", "translate-y-4");
      }

      window.setTimeout(() => {
        modal.classList.remove("flex");
        modal.classList.add("hidden");

        const anyModalOpen = this.$all(".fixed.inset-0.flex:not(.hidden)").length > 0;
        if (!anyModalOpen) {
          this._lockPage(false);
        }
      }, 180);
    },

    closeAllModals() {
      this.closeVariantModal();
      this.closeCameraScanner();
      this.closeCustomerModal();
      this.closeDeliveryModal();
      this.closeVatModal();
      this.closeAttributesModal();
    },

    esc(value) {
      return String(value ?? "")
        .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
        .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
        .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
        .replace(/"/g, "&quot;");
    },

    attr(value) {
      return String(value ?? "")
        .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
        .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
        .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
        .replace(/"/g, "&quot;")
        .replace(/'/g, "&#039;");
    },

    fmt(value) {
      const number = Number(value || 0);
      return number.toLocaleString("vi-VN") + " ₫";
    },

    parseMoney(value) {
      const number = parseInt(String(value || "").replace(/[^\d]/g, ""), 10);
      return Number.isNaN(number) ? 0 : number;
    },

    _fmtMoneyInput(input) {
      if (!input) return;

      const raw = String(input.value || "").replace(/[^\d]/g, "");
      input.value = raw ? parseInt(raw, 10).toLocaleString("vi-VN") : "";
    },

    _fmtCash(input) {
      this._fmtMoneyInput(input);
    },

    _setText(selector, value) {
      const el = this.$(selector);
      if (el) el.textContent = value;
    },

    thumb(url) {
      if (!url) {
        return `
          <div class="w-full h-full grid place-items-center bg-stone-50">
            <i class="fa-solid fa-image text-stone-300"></i>
          </div>
        `;
      }

      return `
        <img
          src="${this.attr(url)}"
          alt=""
          loading="lazy"
          decoding="async"
          class="w-full h-full object-cover object-top"
        >
      `;
    },

    showToast(message, ok = true) {
      const toast = this.$("#posToast");
      const icon = this.$("#posToastIcon");
      const text = this.$("#posToastMsg");

      if (!toast) {
        if (ok) console.log("[POS]", message);
        else console.warn("[POS]", message);
        return;
      }

      toast.classList.remove("hidden");
      toast.classList.add("flex");

      toast.style.backgroundColor = ok ? "#10b981" : "#f43f5e";
      toast.style.borderColor = ok ? "#059669" : "#e11d48";

      if (icon) {
        icon.className = "fa-solid " + (ok ? "fa-check" : "fa-xmark");
      }

      if (text) {
        text.textContent = message || "";
      }

      window.requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        toast.classList.remove("opacity-0");
        toast.classList.add("opacity-100");
      });

      window.clearTimeout(this._toastTimer);

      this._toastTimer = window.setTimeout(() => {
        toast.classList.remove("opacity-100");
        toast.classList.add("opacity-0");

        window.setTimeout(() => {
          toast.classList.remove("flex");
          toast.classList.add("hidden");
        }, 180);
      }, 2600);
    },

    /* =========================================================
       PRODUCT HELPERS
       ========================================================= */

    productVariants(product) {
      return Array.isArray(product?.product_variants)
        ? product.product_variants
        : [];
    },

    productStock(product) {
      const variants = this.productVariants(product);

      if (variants.length) {
        return variants.reduce((sum, variant) => {
          return sum + Number(variant.stock || 0);
        }, 0);
      }

      return Number(product?.stock || 0);
    },

    productPrice(product) {
      return Number(product?.price || 0);
    },

    variantPrice(product, variant) {
      return Number(variant?.price_override || product?.price || 0);
    },

    productSearchText(product) {
      const variants = this.productVariants(product);

      const variantText = variants.map((variant) => {
        return [
          variant.id,
          variant.sku,
          variant.barcode,
          variant.color_name,
          variant.size
        ].filter(Boolean).join(" ");
      }).join(" ");

      return [
        product.id,
        product.name,
        product.slug,
        product.sku,
        product.barcode,
        variantText
      ].filter(Boolean).join(" ").toLowerCase();
    },

    findProductByCode(code) {
      const target = String(code || "").trim().toLowerCase();

      if (!target) return null;

      return this.db.find((product) => {
        const directMatch = [
          product.id,
          product.sku,
          product.barcode,
          product.slug,
          product.name
        ].some((value) => String(value || "").trim().toLowerCase() === target);

        if (directMatch) return true;

        return this.productVariants(product).some((variant) => {
          return [
            variant.id,
            variant.sku,
            variant.barcode
          ].some((value) => String(value || "").trim().toLowerCase() === target);
        });
      }) || null;
    },

    findVariantByCode(product, code) {
      const target = String(code || "").trim().toLowerCase();

      if (!target) return null;

      return this.productVariants(product).find((variant) => {
        return [
          variant.id,
          variant.sku,
          variant.barcode
        ].some((value) => String(value || "").trim().toLowerCase() === target);
      }) || null;
    },

    /* =========================================================
       SEARCH
       ========================================================= */

    filterProducts() {
      const input = this.$("#posSearch");
      const dropdown = this.$("#posDropdown");
      const clearBtn = this.$("#posClearSearch");

      if (!input || !dropdown) return;

      const keyword = input.value.trim().toLowerCase();

      if (clearBtn) {
        clearBtn.style.display = keyword ? "flex" : "none";
      }

      if (!keyword) {
        dropdown.innerHTML = "";
        this._hide(dropdown);
        return;
      }

      const results = this.db
        .filter((product) => this.productSearchText(product).includes(keyword))
        .slice(0, 16);

      dropdown.innerHTML = results.length
        ? results.map((product) => this._renderSearchRow(product)).join("")
        : `
          <div class="p-6 text-center">
            <div class="mx-auto mb-3 w-11 h-11 rounded-full bg-stone-50 grid place-items-center">
              <i class="fa-solid fa-box-open text-stone-300"></i>
            </div>
            <p class="text-[11px] font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-stone-400">
              Không tìm thấy sản phẩm
            </p>
          </div>
        `;

      dropdown.style.display = "block";
      dropdown.classList.remove("hidden");
    },

    _renderSearchRow(product) {
      const stock = this.productStock(product);
      const oos = stock <= 0;

      return `
        <button
          type="button"
          data-pos-dropdown-item
          data-pos-product-id="${this.attr(product.id)}"
          class="w-full flex items-center gap-3 rounded-xl border border-transparent p-2 text-left transition-all hover:border-stone-200 hover:bg-stone-50 active:scale-[.99] ${oos ? "opacity-55 grayscale" : ""}"
        >
          <span class="w-12 h-14 rounded-lg overflow-hidden shrink-0 border border-stone-200 bg-white">
            ${this.thumb(product.thumbnail_url)}
          </span>

          <span class="min-w-0 flex-1">
            <span class="block truncate text-[12px] font-black text-stone-900">
              ${this.esc(product.name)}
            </span>
            <span class="mt-1 block text-[11px] font-black text-blue-600">
              ${this.fmt(this.productPrice(product))}
            </span>
          </span>

          <span class="shrink-0 rounded-lg border px-2 py-1 text-[9px] font-black uppercase tracking-widest ${oos ? "border-rose-200 bg-rose-50 text-rose-600" : "border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700"}">
            ${oos ? "Hết" : stock + " kho"}
          </span>
        </button>
      `;
    },

    clearSearch() {
      const input = this.$("#posSearch");
      const dropdown = this.$("#posDropdown");
      const clearBtn = this.$("#posClearSearch");

      if (input) {
        input.value = "";
      }

      if (clearBtn) {
        clearBtn.style.display = "none";
      }

      if (dropdown) {
        dropdown.innerHTML = "";
        this._hide(dropdown);
      }
    },

    focusSearch() {
      const input = this.$("#posSearch");
      if (input) input.focus();
    },

    /* =========================================================
       USB / BARCODE SCANNER
       ========================================================= */

    _initUsbScanner() {
      document.addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
        const active = document.activeElement;

        const isTypingInput =
          active &&
          ["INPUT", "TEXTAREA", "SELECT"].includes(active.tagName);

        if (isTypingInput) {
          if (event.key === "Enter" && active.id === "posSearch") {
            event.preventDefault();
            const value = active.value.trim();
            if (value) this._onBarcode(value);
          }

          return;
        }

        if (event.key === "Enter") {
          if (this._scannerBuffer.length >= 3) {
            this._onBarcode(this._scannerBuffer);
          }

          this._scannerBuffer = "";
          window.clearTimeout(this._scannerTimer);
          return;
        }

        if (event.key.length === 1) {
          this._scannerBuffer += event.key;
          window.clearTimeout(this._scannerTimer);

          this._scannerTimer = window.setTimeout(() => {
            this._scannerBuffer = "";
          }, 90);
        }
      });
    },

    _onBarcode(code) {
      const normalized = String(code || "").trim();

      if (!normalized) return;

      const search = this.$("#posSearch");

      if (search) {
        search.classList.add("scan-flash");
        window.setTimeout(() => search.classList.remove("scan-flash"), 420);
      }

      const product = this.findProductByCode(normalized);

      if (product) {
        const variant = this.findVariantByCode(product, normalized);

        if (variant) {
          if (Number(variant.stock || 0) <= 0) {
            this.showToast("Biến thể đã hết hàng", false);
            return;
          }

          this.addToCart(product, variant, this.variantPrice(product, variant));
          this.showToast("Đã quét: " + product.name, true);
          return;
        }

        this.showToast("Đã quét: " + product.name, true);
        this.handleSelect(product.id);
        return;
      }

      if (search) {
        search.value = normalized;
        this.filterProducts();
      }

      this.showToast("Không tìm thấy: " + normalized, false);
    },

    /* =========================================================
       QUICK PRODUCT GRID
       ========================================================= */

    renderGrid() {
      const grid = this.$("#quickGrid");

      if (!grid) return;

      if (!this.db.length) {
        grid.innerHTML = `
          <div class="col-span-full rounded-2xl border border-dashed border-stone-200 bg-white p-8 text-center">
            <p class="text-sm font-black text-stone-700">Chưa có sản phẩm</p>
            <p class="mt-1 text-xs text-stone-400">Vui lòng kiểm tra dữ liệu sản phẩm trong admin.</p>
          </div>
        `;
        return;
      }

      grid.innerHTML = this.db.slice(0, 60).map((product) => {
        const stock = this.productStock(product);
        const oos = stock <= 0;

        return `
          <button
            type="button"
            data-pos-product-id="${this.attr(product.id)}"
            class="group overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-stone-200 bg-white text-left shadow-sm transition-all hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:border-blue-400 hover:shadow-lg active:scale-[.985] ${oos ? "opacity-55 grayscale" : ""}"
          >
            <span class="relative block aspect-[3/4] overflow-hidden border-b border-stone-100 bg-stone-50">
              <span class="absolute inset-0 transition-transform duration-500 group-hover:scale-105">
                ${this.thumb(product.thumbnail_url)}
              </span>

              ${oos ? `
                <span class="absolute inset-0 grid place-items-center bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-[2px]">
                  <span class="rounded-lg bg-stone-900 px-3 py-1.5 text-[9px] font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-white">
                    Hết hàng
                  </span>
                </span>
              ` : ""}

              <span class="absolute left-2 top-2 rounded-lg bg-white/95 px-2 py-1 text-[9px] font-black text-stone-600 shadow-sm">
                ${stock} kho
              </span>
            </span>

            <span class="block p-3">
              <span class="line-clamp-2 min-h-[34px] text-[11px] font-black leading-snug text-stone-900">
                ${this.esc(product.name)}
              </span>

              <span class="mt-2 block text-sm font-black text-blue-600">
                ${this.fmt(this.productPrice(product))}
              </span>
            </span>
          </button>
        `;
      }).join("");
    },

    handleSelect(id) {
      const product = this.db.find((item) => String(item.id) === String(id));

      if (!product) return;

      this.clearSearch();

      const variants = this.productVariants(product);

      if (variants.length) {
        this.openVariantModal(product);
        return;
      }

      if (this.productStock(product) <= 0) {
        this.showToast("Sản phẩm đã hết hàng", false);
        return;
      }

      this.addToCart(product, null, this.productPrice(product));
    },

    /* =========================================================
       VARIANT MODAL
       ========================================================= */

    openVariantModal(product) {
      this._variantProduct = product;

      const available = this.productVariants(product).find((variant) => Number(variant.stock || 0) > 0);
      const first = available || this.productVariants(product)[0];

      this._selectedColor = first?.color_name || null;
      this._selectedSize = first?.size || null;

      const title = this.$("#vmTitle");
      const price = this.$("#vmPrice");
      const img = this.$("#vmImg");
      const options = this.$("#vmOptions");

      if (title) title.textContent = product.name || "";
      if (price) price.textContent = this.fmt(this.variantPrice(product, first));
      if (img) img.innerHTML = this.thumb(product.thumbnail_url);

      if (options) {
        options.innerHTML = this._renderVariantOptions(product);
      }

      this._syncVariantButtons();
      this._openOverlay(this.$("#variantModal"), this.$("#vmContent"));
    },

    _renderVariantOptions(product) {
      const variants = this.productVariants(product);

      const colors = Array.from(new Set(
        variants.map((variant) => variant.color_name).filter(Boolean)
      ));

      const sizes = Array.from(new Set(
        variants.map((variant) => variant.size).filter(Boolean)
      ));

      let html = "";

      if (colors.length) {
        html += `
          <div class="mb-5">
            <p class="mb-2.5 text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-stone-400">Màu sắc</p>
            <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
              ${colors.map((color) => {
                const variant = variants.find((item) => item.color_name === color);
                const hex = variant?.color_hex || "#e5e7eb";

                return `
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    data-variant-color="${this.attr(color)}"
                    class="vm-color inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-stone-200 bg-white px-4 py-2.5 text-xs font-black text-stone-600 transition-all hover:border-blue-400"
                  >
                    <span class="w-3 h-3 rounded-full border border-black/10" style="background:${this.attr(hex)}"></span>
                    ${this.esc(color)}
                  </button>
                `;
              }).join("")}
            </div>
          </div>
        `;
      }

      if (sizes.length) {
        html += `
          <div class="mb-2">
            <p class="mb-2.5 text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-stone-400">Kích cỡ</p>
            <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
              ${sizes.map((size) => {
                return `
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    data-variant-size="${this.attr(size)}"
                    class="vm-size min-w-[3rem] rounded-xl border border-stone-200 bg-white px-4 py-2.5 text-center text-xs font-black text-stone-600 transition-all hover:border-blue-400"
                  >
                    ${this.esc(size)}
                  </button>
                `;
              }).join("")}
            </div>
          </div>
        `;
      }

      if (!colors.length && !sizes.length) {
        html += `
          <div class="rounded-xl border border-stone-200 bg-stone-50 p-4 text-xs font-semibold text-stone-500">
            Sản phẩm có biến thể nhưng không có màu / size. Hệ thống sẽ tự chọn biến thể còn hàng đầu tiên.
          </div>
        `;
      }

      return html;
    },

    _syncVariantButtons() {
      this.$all(".vm-color").forEach((button) => {
        const active = button.dataset.variantColor === this._selectedColor;
        this._setVariantButtonActive(button, active);
      });

      this.$all(".vm-size").forEach((button) => {
        const active = button.dataset.variantSize === this._selectedSize;
        this._setVariantButtonActive(button, active);
      });

      const variant = this._getSelectedVariant();
      const price = this.$("#vmPrice");

      if (price && variant && this._variantProduct) {
        price.textContent = this.fmt(this.variantPrice(this._variantProduct, variant));
      }
    },

    _setVariantButtonActive(button, active) {
      const activeClasses = ["ring-2", "ring-blue-600", "border-blue-600", "bg-blue-50", "text-blue-700"];

      if (active) {
        button.classList.add(...activeClasses);
      } else {
        button.classList.remove(...activeClasses);
      }
    },

    _pickColor(color) {
      this._selectedColor = color || null;
      this._syncVariantButtons();
    },

    _pickSize(size) {
      this._selectedSize = size || null;
      this._syncVariantButtons();
    },

    _getSelectedVariant() {
      const product = this._variantProduct;

      if (!product) return null;

      const variants = this.productVariants(product);

      let variant = variants.find((item) => {
        const matchColor = !this._selectedColor || item.color_name === this._selectedColor;
        const matchSize = !this._selectedSize || item.size === this._selectedSize;
        return matchColor && matchSize;
      });

      if (!variant) {
        variant = variants.find((item) => Number(item.stock || 0) > 0) || variants[0] || null;
      }

      return variant;
    },

    confirmVariant() {
      const product = this._variantProduct;
      const variant = this._getSelectedVariant();

      if (!product || !variant) {
        this.showToast("Vui lòng chọn phân loại", false);
        return;
      }

      if (Number(variant.stock || 0) <= 0) {
        this.showToast("Phân loại này đã hết hàng", false);
        return;
      }

      this.addToCart(product, variant, this.variantPrice(product, variant));
      this.closeVariantModal();
    },

    closeVariantModal() {
      const modal = this.$("#variantModal");

      if (!modal || modal.classList.contains("hidden")) return;

      this._closeOverlay(modal, this.$("#vmContent"));
      this._variantProduct = null;
      this._selectedColor = null;
      this._selectedSize = null;
    },

    /* =========================================================
       CART
       ========================================================= */

    addToCart(product, variant, price) {
      const key = variant
        ? `${product.id}_${variant.id}`
        : String(product.id);

      const existing = this.cart.find((item) => item.cid === key);

      if (existing) {
        existing.qty += 1;
      } else {
        this.cart.push({
          cid: key,
          product,
          variant,
          price: Number(price || 0),
          qty: 1
        });
      }

      this.renderCart();
      this.showToast("Đã thêm: " + product.name, true);
    },

    updateQty(cid, delta) {
      const index = this.cart.findIndex((item) => item.cid === cid);

      if (index < 0) return;

      this.cart[index].qty += Number(delta || 0);

      if (this.cart[index].qty <= 0) {
        this.cart.splice(index, 1);
      }

      this.renderCart();
    },

    removeItem(cid) {
      this.cart = this.cart.filter((item) => item.cid !== cid);
      this.renderCart();
    },

    renderCart() {
      const list = this.$("#cartList");
      const empty = this.$("#cart-empty");

      if (!list) return;

      if (!this.cart.length) {
        list.innerHTML = "";

        if (empty) {
          empty.style.display = "flex";
        }

        this.calcTotal();
        return;
      }

      if (empty) {
        empty.style.display = "none";
      }

      list.innerHTML = this.cart.map((item) => {
        const variantText = item.variant
          ? [item.variant.color_name, item.variant.size ? "Size " + item.variant.size : ""].filter(Boolean).join(" / ")
          : "";

        return `
          <div class="flex items-center gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-stone-200 bg-white p-3 shadow-sm transition-all hover:border-blue-300">
            <div class="w-14 h-16 shrink-0 overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-stone-100 bg-stone-50">
              ${this.thumb(item.product.thumbnail_url)}
            </div>

            <div class="min-w-0 flex-1">
              <p class="line-clamp-2 text-[11px] font-black leading-snug text-stone-900">
                ${this.esc(item.product.name)}
              </p>

              ${variantText ? `
                <p class="mt-1 inline-flex rounded-lg bg-stone-100 px-2 py-1 text-[9px] font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-stone-500">
                  ${this.esc(variantText)}
                </p>
              ` : ""}

              <p class="mt-1.5 text-xs font-black text-blue-600">
                ${this.fmt(item.price)}
              </p>
            </div>

            <div class="shrink-0 overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-stone-200 bg-stone-50">
              <button
                type="button"
                data-cart-inc="${this.attr(item.cid)}"
                class="flex h-8 w-9 items-center justify-center text-stone-500 transition-colors hover:bg-white hover:text-blue-600"
                aria-label="Tăng số lượng"
              >
                <i class="fa-solid fa-plus text-[10px]"></i>
              </button>

              <div class="w-9 border-y border-stone-200 bg-white py-1 text-center text-xs font-black text-stone-900">
                ${item.qty}
              </div>

              <button
                type="button"
                data-cart-dec="${this.attr(item.cid)}"
                class="flex h-8 w-9 items-center justify-center text-stone-500 transition-colors hover:bg-white hover:text-rose-600"
                aria-label="Giảm số lượng"
              >
                <i class="fa-solid fa-minus text-[10px]"></i>
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        `;
      }).join("");

      this.calcTotal();
    },

    /* =========================================================
       CUSTOMER / CREATE CUSTOMER / LOYALTY
       ========================================================= */

    openCustomerModal() {
      const modal = this.$("#customerModal");
      const content = this.$("#customerModalContent");

      if (!modal) {
        this.showToast("Chưa có modal thêm khách hàng trong HTML", false);
        return;
      }

      const currentPhone = this.$("#customerPhone")?.value.trim() || "";

      if (currentPhone && this.$("#newCustomerPhone")) {
        this.$("#newCustomerPhone").value = currentPhone;
      }

      this._openOverlay(modal, content);

      window.setTimeout(() => {
        const nameInput = this.$("#newCustomerName");
        const phoneInput = this.$("#newCustomerPhone");

        if (nameInput && !nameInput.value) {
          nameInput.focus();
        } else {
          phoneInput?.focus();
        }
      }, 160);
    },

    closeCustomerModal() {
      this._closeOverlay(this.$("#customerModal"), this.$("#customerModalContent"));
    },

    async createCustomer() {
      const phoneInput = this.$("#newCustomerPhone");
      const nameInput = this.$("#newCustomerName");
      const emailInput = this.$("#newCustomerEmail");
      const addressInput = this.$("#newCustomerAddress");
      const button = this.$("#btnCreateCustomer");

      const phone = phoneInput?.value.trim() || "";
      const fullName = nameInput?.value.trim() || "";
      const email = emailInput?.value.trim() || "";
      const address = addressInput?.value.trim() || "";

      if (!phone) {
        this.showToast("Vui lòng nhập số điện thoại", false);
        phoneInput?.focus();
        return;
      }

      if (!fullName) {
        this.showToast("Vui lòng nhập tên khách hàng", false);
        nameInput?.focus();
        return;
      }

      if (button) {
        button.disabled = true;
        button.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-rotate spin mr-2"></i>Đang lưu...';
      }

      try {
        const response = await fetch(CUSTOMER_CREATE_URL, {
          method: "POST",
          headers: {
            "Content-Type": "application/json",
            "X-CSRFToken": CSRF_TOKEN
          },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            phone,
            full_name: fullName,
            email,
            address
          })
        });

        const data = await response.json();

        if (!data.success) {
          this.showToast(data.message || "Không thể thêm khách hàng", false);
          return;
        }

        const customer = data.customer || {};

        if (this.$("#customerPhone")) {
          this.$("#customerPhone").value = customer.phone || phone;
        }

        if (this.$("#customerName")) {
          this.$("#customerName").value = customer.name || fullName;
        }

        const points = Number(customer.points || 0);

        if (this.$("#lblAvailPoints")) {
          this.$("#lblAvailPoints").textContent = points;
        }

        if (this.$("#redeemPoints")) {
          this.$("#redeemPoints").max = points;
          this.$("#redeemPoints").value = "";
        }

        if (points > 0) {
          this._show(this.$("#loyaltySuggest"));
        } else {
          this._hide(this.$("#loyaltySuggest"));
          this._hide(this.$("#redeemPointsWrapper"), "block");
        }

        this.closeCustomerModal();

        if (phoneInput) phoneInput.value = "";
        if (nameInput) nameInput.value = "";
        if (emailInput) emailInput.value = "";
        if (addressInput) addressInput.value = "";

        this.calcTotal();
        this.showToast(data.message || "Đã thêm khách hàng", true);
      } catch (error) {
        console.error("[POS] createCustomer:", error);
        this.showToast("Lỗi kết nối khi thêm khách hàng", false);
      } finally {
        if (button) {
          button.disabled = false;
          button.textContent = "Lưu khách hàng";
        }
      }
    },

    async lookupCustomer() {
      const phoneInput = this.$("#customerPhone");
      const nameInput = this.$("#customerName");
      const suggestBox = this.$("#loyaltySuggest");
      const redeemWrapper = this.$("#redeemPointsWrapper");
      const redeemInput = this.$("#redeemPoints");
      const pointsLabel = this.$("#lblAvailPoints");

      if (!phoneInput) return;

      const phone = phoneInput.value.trim();

      if (!phone) {
        if (nameInput) nameInput.value = "";
        if (redeemInput) redeemInput.value = "";
        this._hide(suggestBox);
        this._hide(redeemWrapper, "block");
        this.calcTotal();
        return;
      }

      if (nameInput) {
        nameInput.placeholder = "Đang tra cứu...";
      }

      try {
        const response = await fetch(CUSTOMER_LOOKUP_URL, {
          method: "POST",
          headers: {
            "Content-Type": "application/json",
            "X-CSRFToken": CSRF_TOKEN
          },
          body: JSON.stringify({ phone })
        });

        const data = await response.json();

        if (!data.success) {
          if (nameInput) {
            nameInput.value = "";
            nameInput.placeholder = "Tên khách hàng";
          }

          if (redeemInput) redeemInput.value = "";
          this._hide(suggestBox);
          this._hide(redeemWrapper, "block");
          this.calcTotal();

          this.showToast(data.message || "Không tìm thấy khách hàng", false);
          return;
        }

        if (nameInput) {
          nameInput.value = data.name || "";
          nameInput.placeholder = "Tên khách hàng";
        }

        const points = Number(data.points || 0);

        if (pointsLabel) pointsLabel.textContent = points;

        if (redeemInput) {
          redeemInput.max = points;
          redeemInput.value = "";
        }

        if (points > 0) {
          this._show(suggestBox);
          this._hide(redeemWrapper, "block");
        } else {
          this._hide(suggestBox);
          this._hide(redeemWrapper, "block");
        }

        this.calcTotal();
        this.showToast(`${data.name || "Khách hàng"} hiện có ${points} điểm`, true);
      } catch (error) {
        console.error("[POS] lookupCustomer:", error);

        if (nameInput) {
          nameInput.placeholder = "Tên khách hàng";
        }

        this.showToast("Lỗi tra cứu khách hàng", false);
      }
    },

    showRedeemInput(show) {
      const suggestBox = this.$("#loyaltySuggest");
      const redeemWrapper = this.$("#redeemPointsWrapper");
      const redeemInput = this.$("#redeemPoints");

      if (show) {
        this._hide(suggestBox);
        this._show(redeemWrapper, "block");

        if (redeemInput) {
          redeemInput.placeholder = `Tối đa ${redeemInput.max || 0} điểm`;
          redeemInput.focus();
        }

        return;
      }

      this._hide(suggestBox);
      this._hide(redeemWrapper, "block");

      if (redeemInput) redeemInput.value = "";

      this.calcTotal();
    },

    /* =========================================================

      if (!modal) {

      this._openOverlay(modal, content);
    },

    closeDeliveryModal() {

    },

    saveDeliveryInfo() {
      this.deliveryLater = true;
      this.deliveryInfo = {
        receiver_name: this.$("#deliveryReceiverName")?.value.trim() || "",
        receiver_phone: this.$("#deliveryReceiverPhone")?.value.trim() || "",
        address: this.$("#deliveryAddress")?.value.trim() || "",
        date: this.$("#deliveryDate")?.value || "",
        note: this.$("#deliveryNote")?.value.trim() || ""
      };

      this.closeDeliveryModal();
      this._syncDeliveryBadge();
      this.showToast("Đã lưu thông tin giao hàng sau", true);
    },

      this.deliveryLater = false;
      this.deliveryInfo = {};
      this._syncDeliveryBadge();
      this.showToast("Đã tắt giao hàng sau", true);
    },

    _syncDeliveryBadge() {
      const badge = this.$("#deliveryStatusBadge");
      if (badge) {
        badge.textContent = this.deliveryLater ? "Đã bật" : "Chưa bật";
        badge.classList.toggle("text-emerald-600", this.deliveryLater);
      }
    },

    openVatModal() {
      const modal = this.$("#vatModal");
      const content = this.$("#vatModalContent");

      if (!modal) {
        this.vatEnabled = !this.vatEnabled;
        this.showToast(this.vatEnabled ? "Đã bật VAT" : "Đã tắt VAT", true);
        this.calcTotal();
        return;
      }

      this._openOverlay(modal, content);
    },

    closeVatModal() {
      this._closeOverlay(this.$("#vatModal"), this.$("#vatModalContent"));
    },

    saveVatInfo() {
      this.vatEnabled = true;

      const rateInput = this.$("#vatRate");
      let rate = Number(rateInput?.value || this.vatRate || VAT_DEFAULT_RATE);

      if (rate > 1) {
        rate = rate / 100;
      }

      this.vatRate = Math.max(0, Math.min(rate || VAT_DEFAULT_RATE, 1));

      this.vatInfo = {
        company_name: this.$("#vatCompanyName")?.value.trim() || "",
        tax_code: this.$("#vatTaxCode")?.value.trim() || "",
        company_address: this.$("#vatCompanyAddress")?.value.trim() || "",
        email: this.$("#vatEmail")?.value.trim() || ""
      };

      this.closeVatModal();
      this.calcTotal();
      this.showToast("Đã bật hóa đơn VAT", true);
    },

    clearVatInfo() {
      this.vatEnabled = false;
      this.vatInfo = {};
      this.calcTotal();
      this.showToast("Đã tắt hóa đơn VAT", true);
    },

    openAttributesModal() {
      const modal = this.$("#attributesModal");
      const content = this.$("#attributesModalContent");

      if (!modal) {
        this.showToast("Chưa có modal thuộc tính trong HTML", false);
        return;
      }

      this._openOverlay(modal, content);
    },

    closeAttributesModal() {
      this._closeOverlay(this.$("#attributesModal"), this.$("#attributesModalContent"));
    },

    saveAttributes() {
      const rows = this.$all("[data-order-attribute-row]");
      const attrs = [];

      rows.forEach((row) => {
        const key = row.querySelector("[data-attribute-key]")?.value.trim() || "";
        const value = row.querySelector("[data-attribute-value]")?.value.trim() || "";

        if (key) {
          attrs.push({ key, value });
        }
      });

      this.orderAttributes = attrs;
      this.closeAttributesModal();
      this.showToast(`Đã lưu ${attrs.length} thuộc tính`, true);
    },

    addAttributeRow() {
      const wrap = this.$("#orderAttributesRows");
      if (!wrap) return;

      const id = Date.now();

      wrap.insertAdjacentHTML("beforeend", `
        <div data-order-attribute-row class="grid grid-cols-[1fr_1fr_36px] gap-2">
          <input data-attribute-key type="text" class="pos-field" placeholder="Tên thuộc tính">
          <input data-attribute-value type="text" class="pos-field" placeholder="Giá trị">
          <button type="button" onclick="this.closest('[data-order-attribute-row]').remove()" class="rounded-xl bg-rose-50 text-rose-500">
            <i class="fa-solid fa-trash"></i>
          </button>
        </div>
      `);
    },

    /* =========================================================
       TOTALS
       ========================================================= */

    calcTotal() {
      let subtotal = 0;
      let qty = 0;

      this.cart.forEach((item) => {
        subtotal += Number(item.price || 0) * Number(item.qty || 0);
        qty += Number(item.qty || 0);
      });

      const couponDiscount = this._calculateCouponDiscount(subtotal);
      const pointData = this._calculatePointDiscount(subtotal, couponDiscount);

      const discount = Math.min(subtotal, couponDiscount + pointData.discount);
      const taxableAmount = Math.max(0, subtotal - discount);

      const shippingFee = this._getShippingFee();
      const vatAmount = this.vatEnabled ? taxableAmount * this.vatRate : 0;
      const total = Math.max(0, taxableAmount + vatAmount + shippingFee);

      this._lastTotals = {
        subtotal,
        couponDiscount,
        pointDiscount: pointData.discount,
        discount,
        points: pointData.points,
        shippingFee,
        vatAmount,
        total,
        qty
      };

      this._setText("#cartQty", qty);
      this._setText("#txtSubtotal", this.fmt(subtotal));
      this._setText("#txtDiscount", "- " + this.fmt(discount));
      this._setText("#txtShippingFee", this.fmt(shippingFee));
      this._setText("#txtVAT", this.fmt(vatAmount));
      this._setText("#txtTotal", this.fmt(total));
      this._setText("#txtCustomerPay", this.fmt(total));

      const pointsUsed = this.$("#txtPointsUsed");

      if (pointsUsed) {
        if (pointData.points > 0) {
          pointsUsed.textContent = `Đã trừ ${pointData.points} điểm`;
          pointsUsed.classList.remove("hidden");
          pointsUsed.style.display = "inline-flex";
        } else {
          pointsUsed.classList.add("hidden");
          pointsUsed.style.display = "none";
        }
      }

      const checkout = this.$("#btnCheckout");
      if (checkout) {
        checkout.disabled = this.cart.length === 0;
      }

      this.calcChange();
      this._syncCheckoutLabel();

      if (this.method === "transfer") {
        this._updateQR(total);
      }

      return this._lastTotals;
    },

    _getShippingFee() {
      return this.parseMoney(this.$("#posShippingFee")?.value || "0");
    },

    _calculateCouponDiscount(subtotal) {
      const select = this.$("#posCoupon");
      const warn = this.$("#coupon-warn");

      if (warn) {
        warn.classList.add("hidden");
        warn.style.display = "none";
        warn.textContent = "";
      }

      if (!select || !select.value || subtotal <= 0) return 0;

      const option = select.options[select.selectedIndex];

      if (!option) return 0;

      const min = Number(option.dataset.min || 0);

      if (subtotal < min) {
        if (warn) {
          warn.textContent = `Đơn tối thiểu ${this.fmt(min)} để dùng mã này`;
          warn.classList.remove("hidden");
          warn.style.display = "block";
        }

        return 0;
      }

      const type = option.dataset.type;
      const value = Number(option.dataset.value || 0);
      const max = Number(option.dataset.max || 0);

      let discount = type === "percent"
        ? subtotal * (value / 100)
        : value;

      if (max > 0) {
        discount = Math.min(discount, max);
      }

      return Math.max(0, Math.min(discount, subtotal));
    },

    _calculatePointDiscount(subtotal, couponDiscount) {
      const input = this.$("#redeemPoints");

      if (!input) {
        return { points: 0, discount: 0 };
      }

      let points = parseInt(input.value || "0", 10) || 0;
      const maxPoints = parseInt(input.max || "0", 10) || 0;

      if (maxPoints > 0 && points > maxPoints) {
        points = maxPoints;
        input.value = points;
      }

      let discount = points * POINT_REDEEM_VALUE;
      const remaining = Math.max(0, subtotal - couponDiscount);

      if (discount > remaining) {
        discount = remaining;
        points = Math.floor(discount / POINT_REDEEM_VALUE);
        input.value = points > 0 ? points : "";
      }

      return {
        points,
        discount
      };
    },

    calcChange() {
      if (this.method !== "cash") return;

      const cashInput = this.$("#inputCash");
      const changeEl = this.$("#txtChange");
      const givenEl = this.$("#txtCashReceived");

      const total = this._lastTotals.total || 0;
      const given = this.parseMoney(cashInput?.value || "0");
      const change = given >= total ? given - total : 0;

      if (changeEl) {
        changeEl.textContent = this.fmt(change);
        changeEl.style.color = given > 0 && given < total ? "#e11d48" : "#059669";
      }

      if (givenEl) {
        givenEl.textContent = this.fmt(given);
      }
    },

    _syncCheckoutLabel() {
      const label = this.$("#lblCheckout");
      const btn = this.$("#btnCheckout");

      if (!label) return;

      const total = this._lastTotals.total || 0;

      if (btn && btn.disabled) {
        label.textContent = "Đặt hàng";
        return;
      }

      label.textContent = "Thanh toán " + this.fmt(total).replace(" ₫", "");
    },

    suggestCoupon() {
      const select = this.$("#posCoupon");
      const subtotal = this._lastTotals.subtotal || 0;

      if (!select || !select.options.length) {
        this.showToast("Không có mã khuyến mãi khả dụng", false);
        return;
      }

      let bestIndex = -1;
      let bestDiscount = 0;

      Array.from(select.options).forEach((option, index) => {
        if (!option.value) return;

        const min = Number(option.dataset.min || 0);
        if (subtotal < min) return;

        const type = option.dataset.type;
        const value = Number(option.dataset.value || 0);
        const max = Number(option.dataset.max || 0);

        let discount = type === "percent" ? subtotal * value / 100 : value;

        if (max > 0) discount = Math.min(discount, max);
        discount = Math.min(discount, subtotal);

        if (discount > bestDiscount) {
          bestDiscount = discount;
          bestIndex = index;
        }
      });

      if (bestIndex >= 0) {
        select.selectedIndex = bestIndex;
        this.calcTotal();
        this.showToast("Đã áp dụng mã tốt nhất", true);
      } else {
        this.showToast("Không có mã phù hợp với đơn hiện tại", false);
      }
    },

    /* =========================================================
       PAYMENT
       ========================================================= */

    setMethod(method) {
      this.method = method === "transfer" ? "transfer" : "cash";

      const cashBtn = this.$("#btnCash");
      const transferBtn = this.$("#btnTransfer");
      const cashPanel = this.$("#cashPanel");
      const transferPanel = this.$("#transferPanel");

      const activeClass = "rounded-xl border-2 border-blue-600 bg-blue-50 px-4 py-3 text-[11px] font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-blue-700 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition-all";
      const inactiveClass = "rounded-xl border-2 border-transparent bg-stone-100 px-4 py-3 text-[11px] font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-stone-600 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition-all hover:bg-stone-200";

      if (cashBtn) {
        cashBtn.className = this.method === "cash" ? activeClass : inactiveClass;
      }

      if (transferBtn) {
        transferBtn.className = this.method === "transfer" ? activeClass : inactiveClass;
      }

      if (cashPanel) {
        cashPanel.classList.toggle("hidden", this.method !== "cash");
        cashPanel.style.display = this.method === "cash" ? "block" : "none";
      }

      if (transferPanel) {
        transferPanel.classList.toggle("hidden", this.method !== "transfer");
        transferPanel.style.display = this.method === "transfer" ? "block" : "none";
      }

      if (this.method === "transfer") {
        this._updateQR();
      }

      this.calcChange();
    },

    _updateQR(totalOverride) {
      const total = typeof totalOverride === "number"
        ? totalOverride
        : this._lastTotals.total || 0;

      const qr = this.$("#transferQR");

      if (!qr) return;

      const amount = Math.max(0, Math.round(total));
      const addInfo = encodeURIComponent("GUAMAISON POS");
      const accountName = encodeURIComponent(STORE_BANK_NAME);

      qr.src = `https://img.vietqr.io/image/${STORE_BANK_CODE}-${STORE_BANK_ACCOUNT}-compact2.png?amount=${amount}&addInfo=${addInfo}&accountName=${accountName}`;
    },

    async submit() {
      if (!this.cart.length) return;

      const totals = this.calcTotal();
      const phone = this.$("#customerPhone")?.value.trim() || "";
      const customerName = this.$("#customerName")?.value.trim() || "";
      const points = totals.points || 0;

      if (points > 0 && !phone) {
        this.showToast("Nhập số điện thoại để tiêu điểm", false);
        this.$("#customerPhone")?.focus();
        return;
      }

      const cashReceived = this.method === "cash"
        ? this.parseMoney(this.$("#inputCash")?.value || "0")
        : 0;

      if (this.method === "cash" && totals.total > 0 && cashReceived < totals.total) {
        this.showToast("Tiền khách đưa chưa đủ", false);
        this.$("#inputCash")?.focus();
        return;
      }

      const checkout = this.$("#btnCheckout");
      const label = this.$("#lblCheckout");

      if (checkout) checkout.disabled = true;
      if (label) label.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-rotate spin mr-2"></i>Đang xử lý...';

      const payload = {
        payment_method: this.method,

        discount: totals.discount,
        coupon_id: this.$("#posCoupon")?.value || null,

        customer_phone: phone,
        customer_name: customerName,

        redeem_points: points,
        points_used: points,

        cashier_id: this.$("#posCashierId")?.value || null,
        cashier_name: this.$("#posCashierName")?.value || "Nhân viên POS",

        shipping_fee: totals.shippingFee,
        cash_received: cashReceived,

        vat_enabled: Boolean(this.vatEnabled),
        vat_rate: this.vatRate || VAT_DEFAULT_RATE,
        vat_info: this.vatInfo || {},

        delivery_later: Boolean(this.deliveryLater),
        delivery_info: this.deliveryInfo || {},

        order_note: this.$("#posOrderNote")?.value || "",
        order_attributes: this.orderAttributes || [],

        pricebook_id: this.$("#posPricebook")?.value || this.pricebookId || "default",

        items: this.cart.map((item) => ({
          product_id: item.product.id,
          variant_id: item.variant ? item.variant.id : "",
          quantity: item.qty,
          price: item.price,
          name: this._invoiceItemName(item)
        }))
      };

      try {
        const response = await fetch(CHECKOUT_URL, {
          method: "POST",
          headers: {
            "Content-Type": "application/json",
            "X-CSRFToken": CSRF_TOKEN
          },
          body: JSON.stringify(payload)
        });

        const data = await response.json();

        if (!data.success) {
          this.showToast(data.message || "Không thể chốt đơn", false);
          return;
        }

        const invoice = {
          ...(data.invoice || {}),
          payment_method: this.method,
          customer_phone: phone,
          customer_name: customerName,
          cashier_name: payload.cashier_name,
          redeem_points: points,
          subtotal: data.invoice?.subtotal ?? totals.subtotal,
          discount: data.invoice?.discount ?? totals.discount,
          shipping_fee: data.invoice?.shipping_fee ?? totals.shippingFee,
          vat_amount: data.invoice?.vat_amount ?? totals.vatAmount,
          total: data.invoice?.total ?? totals.total,
          cash_received: data.invoice?.cash_received ?? cashReceived,
          change_amount: data.invoice?.change_amount ?? Math.max(0, cashReceived - totals.total),
          items: data.invoice?.items || payload.items
        };

        if (this.method === "cash") {
          this.showToast(data.message || "Thanh toán thành công", true);
          this.printReceipt(invoice);
          this.resetCart();
          return;
        }

        this._pendingInvoice = invoice;
        this.openTransferModal();
        this.startPolling(data.order_id);
      } catch (error) {
        console.error("[POS] checkout:", error);
        this.showToast("Lỗi kết nối máy chủ", false);
      } finally {
        if (label) this._syncCheckoutLabel();
        if (checkout) checkout.disabled = !this.cart.length;
      }
    },

    _invoiceItemName(item) {
      const variantText = item.variant
        ? [item.variant.color_name, item.variant.size ? "Size " + item.variant.size : ""].filter(Boolean).join(" ")
        : "";

      return variantText
        ? `${item.product.name} (${variantText})`
        : item.product.name;
    },

    /* =========================================================
       TRANSFER POLLING
       ========================================================= */

    openTransferModal() {
      const modal = this.$("#transferWaitModal");
      const content = this.$("#twContent");

      this._openOverlay(modal, content);

      const icon = this.$("#twIcon");
      const title = this.$("#twTitle");
      const sub = this.$("#twSub");
      const actions = this.$("#twActions");
      const cancel = this.$("#twCancelBtn");

      if (icon) icon.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-rotate spin"></i>';
      if (title) title.textContent = "Đang chờ thanh toán...";
      if (sub) sub.textContent = "Hệ thống tự động chốt đơn khi nhận được tiền";

      if (actions) {
        actions.classList.add("hidden");
        actions.style.display = "none";
      }

      if (cancel) {
        cancel.style.display = "block";
      }
    },

    startPolling(orderId) {
      if (!orderId) return;

      window.clearInterval(this._pollTimer);

      this._pollTimer = window.setInterval(async () => {
        try {
          const response = await fetch(`/admin/pos-check-payment/${orderId}`, {
            headers: {
              "X-CSRFToken": CSRF_TOKEN
            }
          });

          const data = await response.json();

          if (data.paid) {
            window.clearInterval(this._pollTimer);
            this.onTransferConfirmed();
          }
        } catch (error) {
          console.warn("[POS] polling payment:", error);
        }
      }, 3000);
    },

    onTransferConfirmed() {
      const icon = this.$("#twIcon");
      const title = this.$("#twTitle");
      const sub = this.$("#twSub");
      const actions = this.$("#twActions");
      const cancel = this.$("#twCancelBtn");

      if (icon) {
        icon.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-circle-check text-emerald-500"></i>';
      }

      if (title) {
        title.textContent = "Thanh toán thành công";
      }

      if (sub) {
        sub.textContent = "Chuyển khoản hoàn tất. Có thể in hóa đơn.";
      }

      if (actions) {
        actions.classList.remove("hidden");
        actions.style.display = "flex";
      }

      if (cancel) {
        cancel.style.display = "none";
      }

      this.showToast("Thanh toán thành công", true);
      this.resetCart();
    },

    printReceiptFromModal() {
      if (this._pendingInvoice) {
        this.printReceipt(this._pendingInvoice);
      }
    },

    cancelTransferWait() {
      window.clearInterval(this._pollTimer);
      this.closeTransferModal();
      this.showToast("Đã hủy chờ chuyển khoản", false);
    },

    closeTransferModal() {
      window.clearInterval(this._pollTimer);
      this._closeOverlay(this.$("#transferWaitModal"), this.$("#twContent"));
    },

    /* =========================================================
       CAMERA BARCODE
       ========================================================= */

    openCameraScanner() {
      const modal = this.$("#barcodeCameraModal");
      const content = this.$("#camContent");
      const status = this.$("#bcStatus");

      if (!window.Quagga) {
        this.showToast("Chưa tải được thư viện quét mã", false);
        return;
      }

      this._openOverlay(modal, content);

      if (status) {
        status.textContent = "Đang khởi động camera...";
      }

      const target = this.$("#interactive");

      if (!target) {
        this.showToast("Không tìm thấy vùng camera", false);
        return;
      }

      try {
        Quagga.init({
          inputStream: {
            name: "Live",
            type: "LiveStream",
            target,
            constraints: {
              facingMode: "environment",
              width: 640,
              height: 480
            }
          },
          decoder: {
            readers: [
              "ean_reader",
              "ean_8_reader",
              "code_128_reader",
              "code_39_reader",
              "upc_reader",
              "upc_e_reader"
            ]
          },
          locate: true
        }, (error) => {
          if (error) {
            console.error("[POS] Quagga init:", error);
            if (status) status.textContent = "Không mở được camera";
            return;
          }

          Quagga.start();
          this._cameraOn = true;

          if (status) {
            status.textContent = "Đưa mã vạch vào khung hình";
          }
        });

        this._quaggaDetected = (result) => {
          const code = result?.codeResult?.code;

          if (!code) return;

          if (status) {
            status.textContent = "Đã quét: " + code;
          }

          try {
            Quagga.offDetected(this._quaggaDetected);
          } catch (_) {}

          window.setTimeout(() => {
            this.closeCameraScanner();
            this._onBarcode(code);
          }, 450);
        };

        Quagga.onDetected(this._quaggaDetected);
      } catch (error) {
        console.error("[POS] camera:", error);
        this.showToast("Không thể mở camera", false);
      }
    },

    closeCameraScanner() {
      const modal = this.$("#barcodeCameraModal");
      const content = this.$("#camContent");

      if (window.Quagga && this._cameraOn) {
        try {
          Quagga.stop();
        } catch (_) {}

        this._cameraOn = false;
      }

      this._closeOverlay(modal, content);
    },

    /* =========================================================
       RESET
       ========================================================= */

    resetCart() {
      this.cart = [];
      this._pendingInvoice = null;

      [
        "posCoupon",
        "inputCash",
        "customerPhone",
        "customerName",
        "redeemPoints",
        "posShippingFee",
        "posOrderNote"
      ].forEach((id) => {
        const el = document.getElementById(id);
        if (el) el.value = "";
      });

      const redeemInput = this.$("#redeemPoints");
      if (redeemInput) {
        redeemInput.placeholder = "Nhập số điểm muốn dùng";
        redeemInput.removeAttribute("max");
      }

      this.deliveryLater = false;
      this.deliveryInfo = {};
      this.vatEnabled = false;
      this.vatInfo = {};
      this.orderAttributes = [];

      this._hide(this.$("#loyaltySuggest"));
      this._hide(this.$("#redeemPointsWrapper"), "block");

      const change = this.$("#txtChange");
      if (change) {
        change.textContent = "0 ₫";
        change.style.color = "#059669";
      }

      this.setMethod("cash");
      this.renderCart();
      this.clearSearch();
      this._syncDeliveryBadge();

      const search = this.$("#posSearch");
      if (search && window.innerWidth >= 768) {
        search.focus();
      }
    },

    /* =========================================================
       PRINT 80MM RECEIPT
       ========================================================= */

    printReceipt(invoice) {
      if (!invoice) return;

      const paymentLabel = invoice.payment_method === "transfer"
        ? "Chuyển khoản"
        : "Tiền mặt";

      const items = Array.isArray(invoice.items) ? invoice.items : [];

      const rows = items.map((item, index) => {
        const qty = Number(item.qty || item.quantity || 0);
        const price = Number(item.price || 0);
        const total = qty * price;

        return `
          <tr>
            <td style="text-align:center;padding:3px 2px">${index + 1}</td>
            <td style="padding:3px 4px">${this.esc(item.name || "")}</td>
            <td style="text-align:center;padding:3px 2px">${qty}</td>
            <td style="text-align:right;padding:3px 2px">${price.toLocaleString("vi-VN")}</td>
            <td style="text-align:right;padding:3px 2px">${total.toLocaleString("vi-VN")}</td>
          </tr>
        `;
      }).join("");

      const cashGiven = Number(invoice.cash_received || 0);
      const subtotal = Number(invoice.subtotal || 0);
      const discount = Number(invoice.discount || 0);
      const shippingFee = Number(invoice.shipping_fee || 0);
      const vatAmount = Number(invoice.vat_amount || 0);
      const total = Number(invoice.total || 0);
      const change = Number(invoice.change_amount || Math.max(0, cashGiven - total));

      const cashRows = invoice.payment_method === "cash" && cashGiven > 0
        ? `
          <div class="r"><span>Tiền khách đưa:</span><span>${cashGiven.toLocaleString("vi-VN")}</span></div>
          <div class="r"><span>Tiền thối lại:</span><span>${change.toLocaleString("vi-VN")}</span></div>
        `
        : "";

      const customerRows = invoice.customer_phone
        ? `
          <hr class="d">
          <div class="r"><span>Khách hàng:</span><span class="b">${this.esc(invoice.customer_name || "Khách mua tại quầy")}</span></div>
          <div class="r"><span>SĐT:</span><span>${this.esc(invoice.customer_phone)}</span></div>
        `
        : "";

      const cashierRows = invoice.cashier_name
        ? `
          <div class="r"><span>Thu ngân:</span><span>${this.esc(invoice.cashier_name)}</span></div>
        `
        : "";

      const date = invoice.date || new Date().toLocaleString("vi-VN");
      const orderCode = invoice.order_code || invoice.code || "POS";

      const html = `
        <!DOCTYPE html>
        <html lang="vi">
        <head>
          <meta charset="UTF-8">
          <title>Hóa đơn ${this.esc(orderCode)}</title>
          <style>
            @page { margin: 0; }
            * { box-sizing: border-box; }
            body {
              width: 80mm;
              margin: 0 auto;
              padding: 8mm 4mm;
              color: #000;
              font-family: "Courier New", monospace;
              font-size: 12px;
              line-height: 1.45;
            }
            .c { text-align: center; }
            .b { font-weight: 700; }
            .r { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; }
            .d { border: 0; border-bottom: 1px dashed #000; margin: 7px 0; }
            .store { font-size: 19px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 1px; }
            table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 11px; }
            th { border-bottom: 1px solid #000; padding: 3px 2px; font-weight: 700; }
            td { vertical-align: top; }
            .tot { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 800; }
          </style>
        </head>
        <body>
          <div class="c">
            <div class="store">GUAMAISON</div>
            <div>Official Store</div>
            <div>Hotline: 0909 123 456</div>
          </div>

          <hr class="d">

          <div class="c b" style="font-size:15px;margin:6px 0">
            HÓA ĐƠN BÁN LẺ
          </div>

          <div>
            <div class="r"><span>Số HĐ:</span><span class="b">${this.esc(orderCode)}</span></div>
            <div class="r"><span>Ngày:</span><span>${this.esc(date)}</span></div>
            <div class="r"><span>Thanh toán:</span><span class="b">${paymentLabel}</span></div>
            ${cashierRows}
          </div>

          ${customerRows}

          <hr class="d">

          <table>
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <th style="text-align:center;width:20px">#</th>
                <th style="text-align:left">Tên SP</th>
                <th style="text-align:center;width:24px">SL</th>
                <th style="text-align:right;width:55px">Đ.Giá</th>
                <th style="text-align:right;width:60px">T.Tiền</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>${rows}</tbody>
          </table>

          <hr class="d">

          <div class="r"><span>Tạm tính:</span><span>${subtotal.toLocaleString("vi-VN")}</span></div>

          ${discount > 0 ? `
            <div class="r">
              <span>Giảm giá${invoice.redeem_points > 0 ? ` (${invoice.redeem_points} điểm)` : ""}:</span>
              <span>-${discount.toLocaleString("vi-VN")}</span>
            </div>
          ` : ""}

          ${shippingFee > 0 ? `
            <div class="r">
              <span>Phí vận chuyển:</span>
              <span>${shippingFee.toLocaleString("vi-VN")}</span>
            </div>
          ` : ""}

          ${vatAmount > 0 ? `
            <div class="r">
              <span>VAT:</span>
              <span>${vatAmount.toLocaleString("vi-VN")}</span>
            </div>
          ` : ""}

          <hr class="d">

          <div class="r tot">
            <span>THỰC THU:</span>
            <span>${total.toLocaleString("vi-VN")} ₫</span>
          </div>

          ${cashRows}

          <hr class="d">

          <div class="c" style="margin-top:10px">
            <div class="b">CẢM ƠN QUÝ KHÁCH!</div>
            <div style="font-size:10px;margin-top:4px">
              Giữ hóa đơn để đổi trả theo chính sách cửa hàng.
            </div>
          </div>

          <script>
            window.onload = function () {
              window.print();
              setTimeout(function () { window.close(); }, 500);
            };
          <\/script>
        </body>
        </html>
      `;

      const win = window.open("", "_blank", "width=420,height=680");

      if (!win) {
        this.showToast("Trình duyệt đã chặn cửa sổ in", false);
        return;
      }

      win.document.open();
      win.document.write(html);
      win.document.close();
    }
  };

  window.POS = POS;

  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
    POS.init();
  });
})();
</script>

  <div class="h-full flex flex-col">

    {# ───────────────── HEADER ───────────────── #}

<script>
(function () {
  "use strict";

  const form = document.getElementById("resetPasswordForm");
  const submitBtn = document.getElementById("resetSubmitBtn");
  const submitText = document.getElementById("resetSubmitText");
  const submitIcon = document.getElementById("resetSubmitIcon");
  const password = document.getElementById("password");
  const confirmPassword = document.getElementById("confirm_password");
  const matchMsg = document.getElementById("passwordMatchMsg");
  const strengthBar = document.getElementById("passwordStrengthBar");
  const strengthText = document.getElementById("passwordStrengthText");

  function getStrength(value) {
    let score = 0;

    if (value.length >= 8) score += 1;
    if (value.length >= 12) score += 1;
    if (/[A-Z]/.test(value)) score += 1;
    if (/[a-z]/.test(value)) score += 1;
    if (/[0-9]/.test(value)) score += 1;
    if (/[^A-Za-z0-9]/.test(value)) score += 1;

    return Math.min(score, 5);
  }

  function updateStrength() {
    if (!password || !strengthBar || !strengthText) return;

    const value = password.value || "";
    const score = getStrength(value);

    let width = "0%";
    let color = "#e11d48";
    let text = "Nhập mật khẩu tối thiểu 8 ký tự.";

    if (!value) {
      width = "0%";
      color = "#e11d48";
      text = "Nhập mật khẩu tối thiểu 8 ký tự.";
    } else if (value.length < 8) {
      width = "18%";
      color = "#e11d48";
      text = "Mật khẩu quá ngắn. Cần tối thiểu 8 ký tự.";
    } else if (score <= 2) {
      width = "42%";
      color = "#f97316";
      text = "Mật khẩu còn yếu. Nên thêm chữ hoa, số hoặc ký tự đặc biệt.";
    } else if (score <= 4) {
      width = "72%";
      color = "#c99e14";
      text = "Mật khẩu khá ổn. Có thể dùng được.";
    } else {
      width = "100%";
      color = "#059669";
      text = "Mật khẩu mạnh.";
    }

    strengthBar.style.width = width;
    strengthBar.style.background = color;
    strengthText.textContent = text;
  }

  function checkMatch() {
    if (!password || !confirmPassword || !matchMsg || !submitBtn) return;

    const pass = password.value || "";
    const confirm = confirmPassword.value || "";

    updateStrength();

    if (!confirm) {
      matchMsg.className = "gua-match-msg hidden";
      matchMsg.textContent = "";
      submitBtn.disabled = false;
      return;
    }

    const matched = pass === confirm;
    const longEnough = pass.length >= 8;

    if (!matched) {
      matchMsg.textContent = "✗ Mật khẩu chưa khớp";
      matchMsg.className = "gua-match-msg gua-match-bad";
      submitBtn.disabled = true;
      return;
    }

    if (!longEnough) {
      matchMsg.textContent = "✗ Mật khẩu cần tối thiểu 8 ký tự";
      matchMsg.className = "gua-match-msg gua-match-bad";
      submitBtn.disabled = true;
      return;
    }

    matchMsg.textContent = "✓ Mật khẩu khớp";
    matchMsg.className = "gua-match-msg gua-match-ok";
    submitBtn.disabled = false;
  }

  document.querySelectorAll(".js-toggle-password").forEach((button) => {
    button.addEventListener("click", function () {
      const input = document.getElementById(button.dataset.target);
      const icon = button.querySelector("i");

      if (!input || !icon) return;

      const show = input.type === "password";

      input.type = show ? "text" : "password";
      button.setAttribute("aria-pressed", show ? "true" : "false");
      icon.className = show ? "fa-regular fa-eye-slash" : "fa-regular fa-eye";
    });
  });

  password?.addEventListener("input", checkMatch);
  confirmPassword?.addEventListener("input", checkMatch);

  form?.addEventListener("submit", function (event) {
    if (!password || !confirmPassword || !submitBtn || !submitText || !submitIcon) return;

    const pass = password.value || "";
    const confirm = confirmPassword.value || "";

    if (pass.length < 8 || pass !== confirm) {
      event.preventDefault();
      checkMatch();
      return;
    }

    submitBtn.disabled = true;
    submitText.textContent = "Đang cập nhật";
    submitIcon.className = "fa-solid fa-circle-notch fa-spin";
  });

  window.addEventListener("pageshow", function () {
    if (!submitBtn || !submitText || !submitIcon) return;

    submitBtn.disabled = false;
    submitText.textContent = "Cập nhật mật khẩu";
    submitIcon.className = "fa-solid fa-check";
    checkMatch();
  });

  updateStrength();
})();
</script>
{% endblock %}
</file>
